retraction_and_caveats.nature: Pure arithmetic calculation on hardcoded constants (SOURCE_SIZE=2MiB, DEPS=150MiB, BUILD=40MiB, presumed 50KiB CARE manifest)
retraction_and_caveats.retraction: Retract 'CONFIRMED / empirical / 99.39% storage savings and 99.66% watcher reduction' as measured results. No physical du extents, running build caches, or allocated inotify watcher tables were measured.
retraction_and_caveats.physical_counterpoint: ZCode measured actual du extents at N=3 (u7-worktree-amplification-results.json): plain worktrees save -4.2% when deps dominate; hardlink stores save 42-50% on real starters (upper bound -67.8%).

verdict: HYPOTHETICAL ARITHMETIC PROJECTION ONLY: Illustrates theoretical scaling of build caches and watchers under assumed constants. Physical host allocation and kernel watcher tables remain unmeasured by Antigravity.
